location.name: Israel
location.arrival_instructions:
To ensure a smooth interview experience, here are a couple of things to keep in mind: 

  1. Please plan to arrive 5 to 10 minutes early. Our office manager will be happy to assist you once you arrive on the 10th floor. 

  1. If you're driving to the office, please reply to this email with your license plate number so that we can arrange an entry permit for you. The parking lot entrance is located at 25 Bar Kochva St. Bnei Brak, and you can park where Kaltura is marked or any parking lot that is not marked on the –1-4 floor 

  1. We have a casual office culture without a strict dress code. You’re welcome to dress casually or go for a dress-to-impress look. The important thing is that you feel comfortable. 

  1. To prepare for the interview, we recommend that you review the job description and familiarize yourself with the position's requirements and responsibilities.

details.name: Description
details.value:
This is us 

Kaltura’s (NYSE:KLTR) mission is to power any video experience for any organization – live, on-demand, or real-time. We not only want to make using video simpler, but we also want to better people’s lives through video. Founded in 2006, Kaltura is now a global leader in the video market with millions of people using our products daily to teach, learn, watch, connect, and collaborate. Among our customers, you’ll find more than 1000 global, well-known organizations.    

15+ years since starting the company, we continue to foster a diverse and collaborative work environment where everyone gets a say. Our team is currently 700+ people, and we’re still growing. We have offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, but our technology is all in the cloud.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
The role 

You will join Kaltura’s Media & Telecom division, building and operating mission-critical TV and streaming platforms used by global telecom operators.

This is a hands-on DevOps + SRE hybrid role, focused on engineering, reliability, and large-scale production systems. The team is responsible for designing, improving, and operating highly available services in a fast-moving, production-driven environment.

You will work closely with R&D, NOC, and Product teams, taking ownership of system behavior in production and driving continuous improvements in scalability, performance, and automation.

As a Full-Stack Developer at Kaltura, you will join our Applications R&D team, responsible for developing our core SaaS video portal platform used by millions of users worldwide. You will take ownership of end-to-end feature development, working across both frontend and backend technologies to build scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with Product, Design, DevOps, and QA while leveraging AI-powered development tools to accelerate innovation and deliver exceptional user experiences.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
About the Role 

We are looking for a driven, multilingual Business Development Executive to join our growing commercial team based in our London headquarters. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious sales professional who has already demonstrated success in B2B SaaS sales and is ready to accelerate their career in the Telecom, Media & Entertainment sector. 

You don't need to be a senior salesperson—we're looking for someone with the right mindset, curiosity, resilience, and commercial instinct. We will provide comprehensive training on our technology, products, industry, and sales methodology, giving you everything you need to become a trusted advisor to prospective customers.
